hook.h2: A father asked, and he was answered
hook.text: But Jesus overheard what they said and told the synagogue leader, "Don't fear, only believe."
hook.note: Jairus ran a synagogue. He had a title and people who answered to him, and none of it was any use the day his daughter was dying — so he went and fell down in the road and asked as a father. What he got back is four words, and in this Bible they are RED, because you can see they came from the Son's own mouth. Every dad knows the moment the job stops helping. This is what was said in it.

short350: You have wanted a Father your whole life. Not a doctrine about Him. Not a distant power. A Father — His voice, His heart turned toward you.
Father's Heart Bible is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking.
Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's in RED. The Spirit's in PURPLE.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, words He never spoke are never colored, and narration stays black.

Jairus led a synagogue, but when his daughter was dying he came as a father and fell at the feet of Jesus. He was told not to be afraid, and his child was given back to him. Fathers who ask are heard.
That is what this Bible was made to do. Not to tell you about a Father who speaks, but to show you where He already has.

He is not distant. He is not disappointed. He is your Heavenly Father, and He delights in you as His beloved son. If father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you: the Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood, but the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

An introduction opens each book, a Father's note closes each with a short prayer, and 1,354 notes serve the reader, not the scholar. A presentation page carries their name. Six by nine, hardcover, full color throughout.
A fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek — complete, 66 books and 31,085 verses. A gift, a keepsake, an heirloom.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

body: The Dad's Bible is a color coded Bible for dads, fathers, new dads and stepdads — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking.
Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's words in RED. The Spirit's words in PURPLE.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, the red letter Bible has shown you the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. He has been speaking the whole time. No Bible has ever shown you where.

long.h: Your kids come to you with what they cannot carry. You have a Father you can do the same with.
body: Jairus ran a synagogue, and when his daughter was dying he went and fell at the feet of Jesus. He asked as a father, not as a leader, and he was heard. "Don't fear, only believe." — Mark 5:36. "Little girl, I say to you, get up." — Mark 5:41.

A father asked and was answered. You are a father, and you are also a son with a Father who listens. That sentence opens this edition, before Genesis 1:1, and it is the whole reason the Dad's Bible exists: not to add another standard to a man who is already carrying a household, but to remind him he is somebody's child.

It is a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading and intimacy with God, so you hear Him for yourself. That matters at the kitchen table too. A dad who has read a chapter is in a different position from one repeating what he half remembers — and with the color on the page he can show a kid which words our Father actually said, without owning a commentary.
The same Bible serves a new dad three weeks in, a stepdad still earning his place, and a granddad handing his down. Nothing in it is written down to any of them.

long.h: A three color Bible: red letter, blue letter, purple letter
body: The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation. His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored. Our Father speaks 125,457 words here. The Son speaks 39,936. More than one word in four of this Bible is a divine person speaking.

Nowhere does that land harder than on the Father's own voice. A man who was raised on a distant, disappointed idea of God can turn to any page in this Bible and read, in BLUE, what our Father actually said to His people — and find that He talks to them the way a father talks to a child in his own house.

God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal: "I revealed your name to those you gave me from the world" (John 17:6). This translation lets the Hebrew and Greek speak the distinction they always made: God as Father, Abba Father, your Heavenly Father — and you, His beloved child.

If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name. That is worth a man's attention twice over: once because it tells him who his own Father is, and once because it tells him what he is trying to echo.

A fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek, not adapted from any existing English Bible. Interpretive, with a stated emphasis: the revelation of God as Father. Old Testament readings are weighed against the Masoretic Hebrew; the New Testament follows the modern critical text. Governed by 170 translation rules. Created by Spirit Media Publishing, Kevin White leading the translation, using modern AI language tools under human-authored rules and careful human review. It holds the church's other faithful translations in genuine honor.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

faq.q: What makes the Dad's Bible different from the other editions?
faq.a: It is the complete Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color — every book, every page, nothing abridged — in a cover made for a dad, opening with pages written for him. Those pages put it plainly: your kids come to you with what they cannot carry, and you have a Father you can do the same with. Passages on intimacy, identity and inheritance follow, chosen for dads. From Genesis 1:1 on, it is the same Bible every other edition carries.

faq.q: Is this a family devotional or a parenting book?
faq.a: Neither. It is the Bible itself. There is no parenting curriculum and no dated devotional — an introduction opens each book, a Father's note and short prayer closes each one, and 1,354 study notes run through all 66 books. Dads use it for their own reading and at the table, but what they are reading is Scripture, not a program.

faq.q: Is it a good Father's Day gift?
faq.a: It is what the edition was built for. A 6 x 9 hardcover with a dust jacket and full color throughout, 876 pages, with a presentation page for his name and the date. It is a gift a man keeps rather than a book he already owns four versions of.

faq.q: Does it work for a stepdad or a granddad?
faq.a: Yes. The opening pages speak to a man raising children, in whatever way he came to it, and to the fact that he is a son before he is a father. New dads, stepdads and granddads all read the same complete translation — nothing is pitched at one and withheld from another.

For a hundred and twenty-five years red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and until now those words were printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read it before I buy it?
faq.a: Yes. Every word of the Father's Heart Bible™ is free to read online in twenty-five languages at fathersheartbible.com/read, with English and Telugu also free to listen to. Read Mark 5 tonight and you will see the color for yourself; the print edition is for holding, giving, and handing on.
